newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish currency reserves rise to $17.8 bln in July.
newsitem.headline: Polish currency reserves rise to $17.8 bln in July.

text.p: Polish official foreign currency reserves grew by $160 million in July to $17.8 billion and were $6.84 billion higher than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said official reserves grew $2.83 billion in the January-July period compared to a $4.94 billion rise in the corresponding period of last year.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) JULY 96 JUNE 96 JULY 95
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
